title.zh: 虚构课堂：两个变量与一个对象
title.en: Fictional lecture: two variables and one object

goals.zh: 区分复制引用、修改对象和重新赋值，并解释每一步对程序输出的影响。
goals.en: Distinguish reference copying, object mutation and reassignment, and explain how each changes program output.

title.zh: 两个变量为什么读到同一个值
title.en: Why two variables see the same value

text.zh: 本例所有材料均为原创演示，并非真实课程记录。a 与 b 是两个变量，但 b = a 复制的是 a 所保存的引用。程序只执行了一次 new Counter()，因此只有一个 Counter 对象。通过 b 把 value 改为 3 后，通过 a 访问的是同一个字段，所以打印结果为 3。
text.en: All materials in this example are synthetic, not records of a real course. The variables a and b are distinct, but b = a copies the reference stored in a. Only one new Counter() expression has been evaluated, so there is one Counter object. Setting value to 3 through b updates the same field that is accessed through a, so the printed result is 3.

title.zh: 演示 transcript 的补充：重新赋值

text.zh: 演示 transcript 进一步区分了重新赋值与修改对象。如果接着执行 b = new Counter()，b 会保存新对象的引用，但 a 不会跟着改变，它仍引用原来的对象。因此 a.value 仍是 3。这个区别比只记住“两个变量指向同一个对象”更有用：每次都判断当前语句改变的是变量中保存的引用，还是对象中的字段。
text.en: The synthetic transcript additionally distinguishes reassignment from mutation. If b = new Counter() is executed next, b stores a reference to a new object, while a remains unchanged and still refers to the original object. Consequently a.value remains 3. This distinction is more useful than merely remembering that two variables refer to one object: for each statement, identify whether it changes the reference stored in a variable or a field stored in an object.

text.zh: 在上面的输出之后，执行 b = new Counter(); b.value = 8;。接着分别打印 a.value 和 b.value，会得到什么？先画出两条引用指向的对象，再回答。
text.en: After the output above, execute b = new Counter(); b.value = 8;. What will be printed if a.value and b.value are then printed separately? First draw the objects to which the two references point, then answer.

answer.zh: 分别得到 3 和 8。重新赋值只改变了 b，a 仍指向 value 为 3 的原对象。新 Counter 的 int 字段初始为 0，再被 b.value = 8 改为 8；这次修改没有触及原对象。
answer.en: The outputs are 3 and 8 respectively. Reassignment changed only b; a still refers to the original object with value 3. The int field in the new Counter initially has value 0 and is then changed to 8 by b.value = 8. That mutation does not affect the original object.

definition.zh: 变量保存的对象引用可用于访问对象。复制这个引用不会自动复制对象。
definition.en: An object reference stored in a variable can be used to access the object. Copying the reference does not automatically copy the object.
